stem: A returning worker begins a strenuous greenhouse task in high heat after several weeks away. What is the strongest plan?
choices: Use a more conservative acclimatization plan with water, recovery, monitoring and workload adjustments
Assume prior experience means acclimatization is unnecessary
Remove required PPE so the worker can tolerate the heat
Delay hydration until the worker feels thirsty
rationale: Workers returning after time away may need renewed acclimatization and active heat-risk controls rather than relying on prior experience or thirst.
